name: My Prime Suspect Lady
overview: In a tranquil town, a chilling murder shakes the peace. Detective Logan's investigation takes a twisted turn when he observes suspect Jack entering actress Isabel's home on surveillance footage. As Logan delves deeper into Isabel's world, suspicions of her complicity arise, even as he finds himself drawn to her. But unbeknownst to Logan, Isabel is the true mastermind, luring Jack into her web as her unwitting pawn. As Logan falls deeper under her spell, he becomes her next unsuspecting target in a deadly game of cat and mouse.
